# Soli Deo Gloria

Soli Deo Gloria applies a Gothic, illuminated-manuscript aesthetic with flowing calligraphic typography over a readable layout. Germania-One and Cormorant Garamond are its fonts, and the tailored light and dark palettes are described as inspired by old German Bibles.

![Soli Deo Gloria screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/godlyman-bit/SoliDeoGloria/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Soli Deo Gloria"
    author: "godlyman-bit"
    repo:   "godlyman-bit/SoliDeoGloria"
    slug:   "soli-deo-gloria"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/soli-deo-gloria"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/godlyman-bit/SoliDeoGloria"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/godlyman-bit/SoliDeoGloria/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a Gothic, illuminated-manuscript aesthetic to Obsidian with flowing calligraphic typography and a clean, readable layout. Use Germania-One and Cormorant Garamond with tailored light and dark color palettes inspired by old German Bibles."
}
```
